newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bureaucrats set 48-hr strike for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bureaucrats set 48-hr strike for Tuesday.

text.p: About 1.3 million Venezuelan public sector workers will start a 48-hour strike on Tuesday in protest over delays in bonus payments, union leaders said Monday.
"We are going to paralyze the entire public administration on Tuesday and Wednesday," said Carlos Borges, president of the public sector union FEDEUNEP.
Borges told reporters the government owes employees 71 billion bolivars ($150 million).
Government officials blamed Congress for not approving an additional spending request to make the delayed payments.
"The government has the best intention, as soon as Congress approves it, to process the payments," Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said.
